productionMode: one assembled RexPrompt recipe equals one finished portrait comic page
visualAuthority: approved current-production visual anchors until released StarSplitterVisions canon exists
pageRule: One scene recipe produces one page. Do not combine multiple recipes into a contact sheet, montage, issue summary, spread, cover, or single composite image.
continuityRule: Use continuityFrom plus character visual anchors, region language and the last successful page. Failed, rejected, repeated or superseded generations do not advance production.
letteringRule: Dialogue emitted by the assembler is exact production text. Do not invent, paraphrase, omit, duplicate or reassign it during image generation.
pageDesignRule: Use each recipe's panelPlan as page architecture. Layout may vary, but all specified beats, cast, dialogue and final-page function must remain clear.
visualRule: Strong subject/background value separation. Readability first, scale second, spectacle third. Ground cosmic events in people, inhabited places and material consequences.
